<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api\V1;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Poi;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class PoiController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $query = Poi::with('category', 'dataSource', 'transitStops');

        if ($category = $request->query('category')) {
            $query->whereHas('category', fn($q) => $q->where('slug', $category));
        }
        if ($priceRange = $request->query('price_range')) {
            $query->where('price_range', $priceRange);
        }
        if ($nearStopId = $request->query('near_stop_id')) {
            $maxDistance = $request->query('max_distance', 500);
            $query->whereHas('transitStops', fn($q) => $q->where('transit_stop_id', $nearStopId)
                ->where('distance_meters', '<=', (int)$maxDistance));
        }
        $query->when($request->tags, fn($q, $t) => $q->where(function($q) use ($t) {
            foreach (explode(',', $t) as $tag) {
                $q->whereJsonContains('tags', trim($tag));
            }
        }));
        // Bounding box filter
        if ($bbox = $request->query('bbox')) {
            [$minLng, $minLat, $maxLng, $maxLat] = explode(',', $bbox);
            $query->whereBetween('longitude', [(float)$minLng, (float)$maxLng])
                  ->whereBetween('latitude', [(float)$minLat, (float)$maxLat]);
        }

        $perPage = $request->query('per_page', 50);
        $pois = $query->paginate(min((int)$perPage, 200));

        // Add nearest_stop for each POI
        $pois->through(function ($poi) {
            $poi->nearest_stop = $this->getNearestStop($poi);
            return $poi;
        });

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'data' => $pois->items(),
            'meta' => ['pagination' => [
                'page' => $pois->currentPage(),
                'per_page' => $pois->perPage(),
                'total' => $pois->total(),
            ]],
        ]);
    }

    public function show(int $id): JsonResponse
    {
        $poi = Poi::with(['category', 'dataSource', 'transitStops' => function ($q) {
            $q->orderByPivot('distance_meters')->limit(3);
        }])->find($id);

        if (!$poi) {
            return response()->json(['success' => false, 'message' => 'POI tidak ditemukan'], 404);
        }

        $poi->nearest_stop = $this->getNearestStop($poi);

        return response()->json(['success' => true, 'data' => $poi]);
    }

    private function getNearestStop($poi): ?array
    {
        $stop = $poi->transitStops->sortBy('pivot.distance_meters')->first();

        if (!$stop) {
            return null;
        }

        return [
            'id' => $stop->id,
            'name' => $stop->name,
            'distance_meters' => (int) $stop->pivot->distance_meters,
            'walking_minutes' => (int) $stop->pivot->walking_minutes,
            'latitude' => (float) $stop->latitude,
            'longitude' => (float) $stop->longitude,
        ];
    }
}

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api\V1;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Poi;
use App\Services\AIService;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class SearchController extends Controller
{
    public function __invoke(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $validated = $request->validate(['query' => 'required|string|max:200']);

        $ai = app(AIService::class);
        $filters = $ai->parseSearchQuery($validated['query']);

        $query = Poi::with('category', 'dataSource', 'transitStops');

        if ($category = $filters['category'] ?? null) {
            $query->whereHas('category', fn($q) => $q->where('slug', $category));
        }
        if ($priceRange = $filters['price_range'] ?? null) {
            $query->where('price_range', $priceRange);
        }
        if (!empty($filters['tags'])) {
            foreach ($filters['tags'] as $tag) {
                $query->whereJsonContains('tags', $tag);
            }
        }
        if ($filters['near_transit'] ?? false) {
            $query->whereHas('transitStops', fn($q) => $q->where('distance_meters', '<=', 500));
        }

        $results = $query->limit(20)->get();

        $count = $results->count();
        $categoryLabel = $filters['category'] ?? 'wisata';
        $summary = "Ditemukan {$count} tempat {$categoryLabel}";
        if (!empty($filters['tags'])) $summary .= " dengan " . implode(', ', $filters['tags']);
        if ($filters['near_transit'] ?? false) $summary .= " dekat halte transit";
        $summary .= ".";

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'data' => [
                'parsed_filters' => $filters,
                'results' => $results,
                'ai_summary' => $summary,
            ],
        ]);
    }
}

    public function area(): JsonResponse
    {
        $minLng = $minLat = $maxLng = $maxLat = null;
        $hasBbox = false;

        $raw = request()->input('bbox');
        if ($raw !== null && $raw !== '') {
            if (is_string($raw)) {
                $parts = explode(',', $raw);
                if (count($parts) === 4) {
                    [$minLng, $minLat, $maxLng, $maxLat] = array_map('floatval', $parts);
                    $hasBbox = true;
                }
            } elseif (is_array($raw)) {
                $minLng = (float) ($raw['minLng'] ?? $raw[0] ?? 0);
                $minLat = (float) ($raw['minLat'] ?? $raw[1] ?? 0);
                $maxLng = (float) ($raw['maxLng'] ?? $raw[2] ?? 0);
                $maxLat = (float) ($raw['maxLat'] ?? $raw[3] ?? 0);
                $hasBbox = true;
            }
        }

        // ---- Stats with optional bbox filter ----
        $poiQuery = Poi::query();
        if ($hasBbox) {
            $poiQuery->whereBetween('latitude', [$minLat, $maxLat])
                     ->whereBetween('longitude', [$minLng, $maxLng]);
        }

        $stats = [
            'poi_count_by_category' => Category::withCount(['pois' => function ($q) use ($hasBbox, $minLat, $minLng, $maxLat, $maxLng) {
                if ($hasBbox) {
                    $q->whereBetween('latitude', [$minLat, $maxLat])
                      ->whereBetween('longitude', [$minLng, $maxLng]);
                }
            }])->get()->pluck('pois_count', 'name'),

            'average_transit_friendliness' => (float) (clone $poiQuery)->avg('transit_friendliness_score'),
            'total_transit_stops'          => TransitStop::count(),
            'total_transit_routes'         => TransitRoute::count(),
            'data_sources'                 => DataSource::pluck('name'),
        ];

        // ---- Underserved hotspots ----
        // Cari POI dengan jarak ke halte > 500m (dari poi_transit_stops) ATAU transit_friendliness_score < 6
        $underservedQuery = Poi::select('id', 'name', 'latitude', 'longitude', 'transit_friendliness_score');

        if ($hasBbox) {
            $underservedQuery->whereBetween('latitude', [$minLat, $maxLat])
                             ->whereBetween('longitude', [$minLng, $maxLng]);
        }

        $underservedHotspots = $underservedQuery
            ->where(function ($q) {
                // Kondisi underserved: skor rendah, atau tidak ada stop terdekat, atau jarak > 500m
                $q->whereNull('transit_friendliness_score')
                  ->orWhere('transit_friendliness_score', '<', 6)
                  ->orWhereRaw('NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM poi_transit_stops WHERE poi_id = pois.id)')
                  ->orWhereRaw('COALESCE((SELECT MIN(distance_meters) FROM poi_transit_stops WHERE poi_id = pois.id), 999999) > 500');
            })
            ->orderBy('transit_friendliness_score', 'asc')
            ->limit(10)
            ->get();

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'data' => array_merge($stats, [
                'underserved_hotspots' => $underservedHotspots,
                'ai_insight' => 'Kawasan Malioboro sampai Kotagede memiliki kerapatan POI tertinggi dengan rata-rata jarak ke halte 280 meter. Area Ring Road Utara hingga Jalan Kaliurang memiliki skor transit di bawah 5.0 — perlu prioritas pengembangan.',
            ]),
        ]);
    }

            'poi_ids.*' => 'exists:pois,id',

        // Simple route optimizer: sort by transit score desc then by proximity
        $ordered = $pois->sortByDesc('transit_friendliness_score')->values();

        $itinerary = Itinerary::create([
            'session_token' => $validated['session_token'],
            'title' => 'Trip: ' . $ordered->first()->name . ' → ' . $ordered->last()->name,
            'total_estimated_minutes' => $ordered->count() * 60,
            'share_slug' => 'trip-' . Str::random(8),
        ]);

        $items = [];
        foreach ($ordered as $i => $poi) {
            $nearestStop = $poi->transitStops->sortBy('pivot.distance_meters')->first();
            $items[] = ItineraryItem::create([
                'itinerary_id' => $itinerary->id,
                'poi_id' => $poi->id,
                'visit_order' => $i + 1,
                'suggested_transit_stop_id' => $nearestStop?->id,
                'estimated_arrival_time' => sprintf('%02d:00', 8 + $i * 2),
            ]);
        }

        // --- Generate AI narrative ---
        $poiData = $ordered->map(fn(Poi $p) => [
            'name' => $p->name,
            'category_name' => $p->category?->name ?? 'Umum',
            'transit_score' => $p->transit_friendliness_score ?? 5,
        ])->toArray();

        $ai = app(AIService::class);
        $narrative = $ai->generateItineraryNarrative($poiData);

        // --- Fallback: route-optimizer-based narrative if AI returned empty ---
        if (empty(trim($narrative))) {
            $optimizer = app(RouteOptimizerService::class);
            $routePois = $ordered->map(fn(Poi $p) => [
                'latitude' => (float) $p->latitude,
                'longitude' => (float) $p->longitude,
                'name' => $p->name,
            ])->toArray();
            $optimized = $optimizer->optimizeOrder($routePois);
            $names = collect($optimized)->pluck('name');
            $narrative = "Mulai perjalanan dari **{$names->first()}**, lanjut menjelajahi " .
                         $names->slice(1, -1)->implode(', ') .
                         ", dan akhiri di **{$names->last()}**. " .
                         "Setiap lokasi bisa dijangkau dengan Trans Jogja dalam jarak jalan kaki yang nyaman.";
        }

        $itinerary->update(['ai_narrative' => $narrative]);
        $itinerary->load('items.poi', 'items.suggestedTransitStop');

        return response()->json(['success' => true, 'data' => $itinerary], 201);
    }

namespace App\Services;

class RouteOptimizerService
{
    /**
     * Sort POIs for optimal visiting order.
     * Uses nearest-neighbor heuristic: start from first, keep picking closest.
     */
    public function optimizeOrder(array $pois): array
    {
        if (count($pois) <= 2) {
            return $pois;
        }

        $ordered = [$pois[0]];
        $remaining = array_slice($pois, 1);

        while (!empty($remaining)) {
            $last = end($ordered);

            $nearestIdx = null;
            $nearestDist = PHP_FLOAT_MAX;

            foreach ($remaining as $idx => $candidate) {
                $dist = $this->distance(
                    $last['latitude'], $last['longitude'],
                    $candidate['latitude'], $candidate['longitude']
                );
                if ($dist < $nearestDist) {
                    $nearestDist = $dist;
                    $nearestIdx = $idx;
                }
            }

            $ordered[] = $remaining[$nearestIdx];
            array_splice($remaining, $nearestIdx, 1);
        }

        return $ordered;
    }

    /**
     * Reorder and attach transit info.
     * Returns array of [poi, nearest_stop, distance_meters, walking_minutes]
     */
    public function buildRoute(array $pois, array $allStops): array
    {
        $ordered = $this->optimizeOrder($pois);
        $transitScore = new TransitScoreService();

        $route = [];
        foreach ($ordered as $poi) {
            $nearest = null;
            $minDist = PHP_FLOAT_MAX;

            foreach ($allStops as $stop) {
                $dist = $this->distance(
                    $poi['latitude'], $poi['longitude'],
                    $stop['latitude'], $stop['longitude']
                );
                if ($dist < $minDist) {
                    $minDist = $dist;
                    $nearest = $stop;
                }
            }

            $route[] = [
                'poi' => $poi,
                'nearest_stop' => $nearest,
                'distance_meters' => (int) $minDist,
                'walking_minutes' => $transitScore->walkingMinutes((int) $minDist),
            ];
        }

        return $route;
    }

    private function distance(float $lat1, float $lng1, float $lat2, float $lng2): float
    {
        $dLat = deg2rad($lat2 - $lat1);
        $dLng = deg2rad($lng2 - $lng1);
        $a = sin($dLat / 2) ** 2 + cos(deg2rad($lat1)) * cos(deg2rad($lat2)) * sin($dLng / 2) ** 2;
        return 2 * atan2(sqrt($a), sqrt(1 - $a));
    }
}

namespace App\Services;

class TransitScoreService
{
    const EARTH_RADIUS = 6371000; // meters

    public function calculateScore(float $distanceMeters, ?int $frequencyMinutes = null): float
    {
        // Distance score: 0-500m = 10, 500-1000m = 7, 1000-1500m = 4, >1500m = 1
        $distanceScore = match (true) {
            $distanceMeters <= 200 => 10.0,
            $distanceMeters <= 500 => 9.0,
            $distanceMeters <= 800 => 7.0,
            $distanceMeters <= 1000 => 5.0,
            $distanceMeters <= 1500 => 3.0,
            default => 1.0,
        };

        // Frequency bonus: frequent = higher score
        $frequencyScore = 1.0;
        if ($frequencyMinutes !== null) {
            $frequencyScore = match (true) {
                $frequencyMinutes <= 5 => 1.0,
                $frequencyMinutes <= 10 => 0.9,
                $frequencyMinutes <= 20 => 0.7,
                default => 0.5,
            };
        }

        return round($distanceScore * $frequencyScore, 1);
    }

    public function getLabel(float $score): string
    {
        return match (true) {
            $score >= 8.0 => 'Sangat Mudah Diakses',
            $score >= 6.0 => 'Mudah Diakses',
            $score >= 4.0 => 'Cukup Diakses',
            default => 'Kurang Terjangkau',
        };
    }

    public function haversineDistance(float $lat1, float $lng1, float $lat2, float $lng2): int
    {
        $dLat = deg2rad($lat2 - $lat1);
        $dLng = deg2rad($lng2 - $lng1);
        $a = sin($dLat / 2) ** 2 + cos(deg2rad($lat1)) * cos(deg2rad($lat2)) * sin($dLng / 2) ** 2;
        $c = 2 * atan2(sqrt($a), sqrt(1 - $a));
        return (int) round(self::EARTH_RADIUS * $c);
    }

    public function walkingMinutes(int $distanceMeters): int
    {
        return (int) round($distanceMeters / 80); // avg walking speed ~80m/min
    }
}

## Summary: Fields Returned in API Responses

| Endpoint | Relations Loaded on POI | Extra Computed Fields | Pagination |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET /pois` | category, dataSource, transitStops (all stops) | `nearest_stop` (array: id, name, distance_meters, walking_minutes, lat, lng) | Yes (default 50, max 200) |
| `GET /pois/{id}` | category, dataSource, transitStops (top 3 by distance) | `nearest_stop` (same shape) | No |
| `POST /search` | category, dataSource, transitStops (all stops) | None | Limit 20 (no pagination) |
| `POST /itineraries` | transitStops, category (on creation) | None (full POI model embedded in items) | No |
| `GET /itineraries/{slug}` | items.poi, items.suggestedTransitStop | None | No |
| `GET /insight/area` | None (raw query on POI) | Only returns id, name, lat, lng, transit_friendliness_score for hotspots | No |

**Key observations:**
1. There are **no API Resources or transformers** -- responses return fully serialized Eloquent models.
2. The `nearest_stop` computed field in PoiController is the only custom transformation applied to POI data.
3. `InsightController` does not use `AIService::generateAreaInsight()` despite the method existing -- it uses a hardcoded string.
4. The `AIService` gracefully degrades to rule-based keyword matching when the API key is missing or the request fails.
5. All coordinates use `decimal(10,7)` precision with casts to `decimal:7` in models.
6. The `tags` JSON column is queried via `whereJsonContains` which requires MySQL 5.7+ / MariaDB 10.2+ JSON support.
